image.name: kdenlive
image.description: [Kdenlive](https://kdenlive.org/) is a powerful free and open source cross-platform video editing program made by the KDE community. Feature rich and production ready.

changelog.desc: Make Wayland default disable with PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=false.
Rebase to Arch latest Appimage no longer working on Deb distros. Build for arm64 again.
Fix cpu bug, disable gamepad by default.
Rebase to Selkies and use official AppImage, HTTPS IS NOW REQUIRED. Remove arm64 support.
Rebase to noble. Use pypi and lsio wheels.
Update Readme with new env vars and ingest proper PWA icon.

volumes.desc: Users home directory in the container, stores local files and settings

ports.desc: Kdenlive desktop gui HTTP, must be proxied.

custom.name: shm-size
custom.desc: This might be needed to prevent crashing

image.title: Kdenlive
image.setup_instructions:
The application can be accessed at:

* https://yourhost:3001/

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  kdenlive:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/kdenlive:latest
    container_name: kdenlive
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
    volumes:
      - /path/to/kdenlive/config:/config
    ports:
      - 3000:3000
      - 3001:3001
    shm_size: "1gb" #optional
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=kdenlive \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  -p 3001:3001 \
  -v /path/to/kdenlive/config:/config \
  --shm-size="1gb" `#optional` \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/kdenlive:latest
